comparison.objective: Free a trapped hand from beneath a stopped, braked robot arm; candidate removes four threaded-insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Safe load relief and human-hand extraction around a constrained arm versus recessed impact tooling and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Hand freed without unsafe arm motion or further trapping versus four safe fractures and complete containment.
comparison.reason: Emergency release/load management is materially different from manufacturing fracture. The record body and quantitative safety rubric are absent.
